name: @myzonerocks/gossveil
description: Sessions, groups, sealed envelopes and safety numbers for the browser and Node, over a wasm core

scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:js
scripts.build:core: cd ../.. && zig build wasm -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && mkdir -p sdk/ts/wasm && cp zig-out/wasm/gossveil.wasm sdk/ts/wasm/gossveil.wasm
